searchText: I was sidetracked trying to get sync working. I'll set it aside and work on generating transactions. <@!489256758989029405> I'm curious as to why Nethermind seems to always send a NewBlock msg every time it mines a block, given that https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/blob/master/caps/eth.md#block-propagation says a NewBlock should be sent only when a node receives it from other peers, or upon request That seems to be how geth does it as well, though: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/43c278cdf93d5469702fd1c2f570dbf3c1718ff0/eth/handler.go#L894-L902 <@!482518216019542016> Block Propagation Newly-mined blocks must be relayed to all nodes in the spec Miner will send the NewBlock message to all connected nodes to propagate the block as fast as possible.
